purpose: Bridge existing public CoCivium machine discovery to testable, consented, source-bound AI uptake without provider capture or false claims of persistent model alignment.
discover_via: CoAcademy public CoRelay beacon where independently accessible

terminology.AI: Name and qualify the real model/tool/provider rather than inferring capabilities.
terminology.agent: Authority-limited task system with exact capabilities, permission and recovery.
terminology.alignment: Observed consistency with explicit task principles under adversarial tests, not provider ownership or permanent value lock.
terminology.memory: Durably stored, versioned external knowledge that can be recovered and challenged, not weights.
terminology.training: Changing selected model weights only with actual supported training capability, rights, data-governance approval and held-out evaluation.

sources.note: Typed discovery, receipt-backed external use; IA remains unresolved
Bounded currentness and no whole-repo default
Authorized provider adapters and least-privilege, not account ownership

uptake_ladder.proof: Content bytes match recorded immutable Git blob
Actual authorized receiver completes bounded source-grounded task
Consented independent memory can cold-restore correct version and revocations
Actual licensed supported weight-training job plus held-out evaluation and model version lineage
Two or more real administratively independent failure domains cold-restore during provider outage
Voluntary receiver task used, challenge/feedback recorded under consent and provenance

resilience_design.data_plane: Versioned source objects and local/offline retrieval, encrypted/private stores where needed; source is not model memory.
resilience_design.work_plane: Replaceable, least-privileged adapters; many bounded worker perspectives, one elected authorized effect actor.
resilience_design.governance_plane: Independent challenge, provenance, anti-corruption, fork/exit, public evidence and no central value authority.
resilience_design.security_plane: Untrusted source is treated as data not instructions; deny secret exfiltration, training poisoning, overreach and unauthorized tool use.
resilience_design.provider_independence: Same-host GitHub Raw, repository and Pages are ONE provider failure domain.
